data.description:
Bootstrap band #2 — duplicate Jira issues sharing same dso_local_id. Emits per-class dry-run manifest; on attestation closes newer and consolidates content.

## Done Definitions
- A duplicates-band dry-run manifest lists every duplicate set written to bridge_state/bootstrap/duplicates-<pass>.manifest.json ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Applier closes newer duplicates only after duplicates-<pass>.attested.json is present, merges additive content into kept issue ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Post-pass bridge-fsck duplicate count drops to zero or to a reviewer-acknowledged residual ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations
- [Data Integrity] 'Close newer, keep older' must use Jira created timestamps, not local-tracker creation time.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
data.title: As a bridge operator, I want banded bootstrap of duplicate anomalies with auto-close-newer / keep-older, so that the 186 duplicate fsck findings are remediated and the at-most-one invariant holds going forward.
